metadata.title: policy-as-versioned-flux — Kyverno ValidatingPolicy component
metadata.remarks: C2P component-definition: maps each hand-authored Kyverno ValidatingPolicy (the Check_Id result2oscal string-matches against PolicyReport results[].policy, version suffix stripped) to the NIST 800-53r5 control it evidences. This is the sole policy<->control mapping for the up-flow; add a control-mapping[] entry to teach result2oscal a new policy.

components.title: Kyverno CEL ValidatingPolicy engine
components.description: The single versioned Kyverno engine; one result stream (wgpolicyk8s.io PolicyReports) for both planes.

implemented-requirements.description: Least Privilege — a workload runs as non-root, or (if root) is attested + hardened.
Configuration Settings — versioned policy is pinned; unversioned workloads are rejected.
